source: Kementerian Agama Republik Indonesia (Kemenag), Kota Jakarta, DKI Jakarta. Full year 2026 (365 dates), fetched live from POST https://bimasislam.kemenag.go.id/ajax/getShalatbln (provinsi=DKI Jakarta, kabko=Kota Jakarta), one call per month.
Times are transcribed directly from that response (subuh->fajr, terbit->sunrise, dzuhur->dhuhr, ashar->asr, maghrib->maghrib, isya->isha), not computed by this library.
